movers.text: Brentford's first-choice striker Igor Thiago is suspended for three Premier League games, starting vs Everton on 11/23 (BBC).
Brentford defenders Nathan Collins (centre-back) and Aaron Hickey (full-back) are out for several weeks, per Keith Andrews; Rico Henry is also out. Lineups confirmed an hour before kickoff.
Everton's Jack Grealish (regular starter, left wing) is available again after missing time with illness and a club-protocol breach, per David Moyes.
Chelsea striker João Pedro (thigh) is out until about January (Alonso); Reece James (knee) is also out, and Moisés Caicedo went off vs Leeds on 11/21 with a back knock.
Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya hurt his shoulder at Newcastle on 11/21 (MRI; Arteta: 'not good news'); Saka is about four weeks away and Zubimendi (hamstring) out a few weeks.

BRE.text: Brentford's first-choice striker Igor Thiago is suspended for three Premier League games, starting vs Everton on 11/23 (BBC).
Brentford defenders Nathan Collins (centre-back) and Aaron Hickey (full-back) are out for several weeks, per Keith Andrews; Rico Henry is also out. Lineups confirmed an hour before kickoff.

EVE.text: Everton's Jack Grealish (regular starter, left wing) is available again after missing time with illness and a club-protocol breach, per David Moyes.

CHE.text: Chelsea striker João Pedro (thigh) is out until about January (Alonso); Reece James (knee) is also out, and Moisés Caicedo went off vs Leeds on 11/21 with a back knock.

SUN.text: Sunderland's joint-top scorer Brian Brobbey (thigh) and midfielder Granit Xhaka (calf) are out with no return date; Dan Ballard and Romaine Mundle are out until late December.

ARS.text: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya hurt his shoulder at Newcastle on 11/21 (MRI; Arteta: 'not good news'); Saka is about four weeks away and Zubimendi (hamstring) out a few weeks.

TOT.text: Spurs attackers Xavi Simons and Wilson Odobert (knees), Mathys Tel and Mykhailo Mudryk are out; Sandro Tonali (illness) is a doubt.
